images.screen: A · 정차 중 — comparing passengers with their window reflections
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Side-on view straight across the interior of a Seoul subway car on the last train at night. Eight passengers sit on a long teal vinyl bench in the foreground, stylized flat-shaded 2D illustration with clean silhouettes: a man in a navy jacket, a woman in burgundy knit with a shopping bag, a man in a red cap, an older man reading a newspaper, a schoolgirl, a hiker, a hooded teen with a glowing phone, and a woman in a beige trench coat. Behind them three black tunnel windows show their ghostly blue-green reflections, with amber tunnel lights streaking past. One reflection is wrong: the trench-coat woman's reflection faces the viewer with pale eyes and a too-wide grin, one palm pressed to the glass, circled by a red dashed marker. Cold fluorescent green-white lighting, hanging strap loops, chrome poles, subtle scanlines and vignette. HUD: green line badge "2", station name "을지로3가", circular door timer, bottom-left comparison panel "창문 반사" with a button "내리게 하기". Text constraints: the announcement reads exactly "이번 역은 을지로3가입니다" and the next-station arrow reads "을지로4가"; no real transit-operator logo or name (no "서울교통공사") and no real brand names on bags or clothing.

images.screen: B · 놓쳤다 — the monster stayed on board
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same subway car interior seen side-on, now inside the tunnel with the main lights dead and red emergency lighting pulsing. Passengers still sit on the bench in flat-shaded 2D style, but one seat is empty, marked only by a wet umbrella mark — yet in the black window above it, the trench-coat woman's reflection is still sitting there. Every reflection in all three windows has turned its head toward the viewer with pale dot eyes, and a huge blurred grinning face looms faintly across the middle window. Heavy red vignette, scanlines, flicker, deep crimson and black palette with a single sick pink highlight. Large shaking red warning text "놓쳤다" in the center with a caption strip below it, red station line badge, a four-segment danger meter labeled "반사 번짐", and a bottom-left panel reading "아무도 없다. 반사는 있다." Tense survival-horror mood, readable HUD hierarchy. Consistency: the trench-coat woman is NOT physically present anywhere on the bench — her seat is empty with only a wet mark — and she appears only as a reflection in the window above that empty seat. The line badge is the same number "2" as the earlier screen, recolored red; no other line name.
